sentences.text:
Jhallo Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8
April, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 11360 of 2025

Applicant :- Jhallo Devi And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Anand Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Pankaj Saxena, learned
Aga for the State.
2.

The instant application has been filed for quashing the charge sheet dated 17.11.2022 as well as
cognizance order dated 12.04.2023 including the entire proceeding of Case No.57312 of 2023,
arising out of Case Crime No.13 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Chaubeypur, District Varanasi, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial
Magistrate-VIth, Varanasi.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise.
It has been requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of aforesaid compromise.

sentences.text: Though this fact has not been disputed by learned AGA but he has raised a preliminary objection that the aforesaid proceeding cannot be quashed on the basis of compromise.
The aforesaid compromise should be verified by the court below before quashing the impugned proceeding.
5. In view of the above, the applicants are directed to file original deed of the compromise before the court below within a period of 15 days from today.

On filing of such compromise, the court below will verify the same within a period of two months after summoning the parties and after verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding , in accordance with law.
6. For a period of two months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
7. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
8. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 8.4.2025 A.Kr.
